summary.text: April Osentoski is the Democratic candidate for Michigan State Senate District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 4 Democratic primary.
A chef, she was the Democratic nominee for Michigan House District 98 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Osentoski was born in Detroit and works as a chef.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has more than 25 years of experience as a culinary professional, rose to executive chef at an assisted living facility, and has performed with the Port Austin Community Players.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for Michigan House of Representatives District 98 in 2024 and lost the general election to incumbent Gregory Alexander.

Osentoski's survey listed three key messages: expanded mental health services including substance abuse treatment, economically viable futures for young people, and safety and security for the aging population.
She named health care, education, economic growth, infrastructure and the environment as policy areas she is passionate about.
